name: Ikuma Chitose
source:
Class: 2-B
Favorite food: Local gourmet food, sour things. She has transferred so many times that her preferences keep changing often.
Hobbies: Mountain biking, reading, running
Troubles: For some reason she keeps getting wet during nighttime.

A girl who is a big fan of comedy. She met [url=/c78241]Yuuya[/url] once during their childhood during a summer vacation. However, she managed to be with only for a while because she was visiting her relatives' house, and never saw him again until she moved and transferred to his school.

She is often seen hanging out with [url=/c8482]Marina[/url].
